title: Get Sourcing Plugin Working End to End
description: Get the sourcing plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing, curation artifact, sourcing-editor/viewer apps in 🌎️hub compositions, dev variant) to work end to end: builds, tests pass, loads in s, artifacts editable/viewable in the browser, events persisted and replayed.
summary: Duplicate of the open ticket 26/09/01/SOURCING-END-TO-END, which already covers getting sourcing working end to end with every feature; the work continues there (agent rules and coordination plan copied as 📓️agent-rules-2026-11-27.md and 🗺️coordination-plan-2026-11-27.md).
